segments.name: Commercial Flight Equipment Segment
segments.evidence: We manage our business and analyze and report our results of operations on the basis of one business segment: leasing, financing, sales and management of commercial flight equipment ("Commercial Flight Equipment Segment").

revenueModel.text: Airlines and other operators pay AerCap lease rents, including supplemental maintenance rents, under operating and finance leases of flight equipment.
revenueModel.evidence: We lease most of our flight equipment to customers under operating leases.
